# Notice the typo in the previous path ("archa-matrix" instead of "aroha-matrix"). Let's fix that typo, clear the lingering test file, and test again.
Remove-Item "$HOME\aroha-matrix\auto-ha\config\queue\test-clip.json" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$testPayload = @{ timestamp = (Get-Date).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"); source = "manual-test"; content = "Aroha matrix pipeline test" } | ConvertTo-Json
$testPayload | Out-File -FilePath "$HOME\aroha-matrix\auto-ha\config\queue\test-clip.json" -Encoding utf8
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
Get-ChildItem -Path "$HOME\aroha-matrix\auto-ha\config\queue" -Recurse
Get-ChildItem -Path "$HOME\aroha-matrix\auto-ha\config\processed" -Recurse
